seoTitle: How to Use Lucidchart in Google Sheets Easily
metaDescription: Install the Lucidchart add-on in Google Sheets to embed flowcharts and diagrams directly into your spreadsheet with automatic refresh.
intro: Pairing visual diagrams with your spreadsheet data can make process maps and flowcharts easier to reference alongside the numbers. The Lucidchart add-on for Google Sheets lets you embed diagrams directly into your sheet and refresh them whenever your source diagram changes. This guide covers the installation and embedding process.

steps.heading: Open the Google Workspace Marketplace
steps.body: From your spreadsheet, access the Marketplace to search for the Lucidchart add-on.

steps.heading: Install the add-on
steps.body: Install the Lucidchart Diagrams extension and grant the requested account permissions.

steps.heading: Launch Lucidchart from Extensions
steps.body: Open the add-on from your spreadsheet's Extensions menu to access the sidebar.

steps.heading: Browse your saved documents
steps.body: Use the sidebar document browser to find the diagram you want to insert.

steps.heading: Customize placement and scaling
steps.body: Adjust image scaling and cell placement options before inserting the diagram.

steps.heading: Insert and refresh the diagram
steps.body: Add the flowchart to your active spreadsheet, and use the refresh feature to pull in recent design changes later.

faq.question: Can I update the embedded diagram without re-inserting it?
faq.answer: Yes, the refresh feature is designed to pull recent changes from Lucidchart into the already-embedded diagram.

faq.question: Do I need a separate Lucidchart account?
faq.answer: Yes, you'll need to log in and authenticate your Lucidchart account within the sidebar to browse and insert your diagrams.

faq.question: What kinds of diagrams can I embed this way?
faq.answer: Flowcharts and mind maps are common examples, though any diagram saved in your Lucidchart account can typically be embedded.

faq.question: Where does the diagram appear in my spreadsheet?
faq.answer: You can customize cell placement and image scaling before inserting, so the diagram sits wherever you need it on the sheet.
